scope: Id representation cleanup and necessity review
removed: unused RawVtable pointer/capacity mirror and synchronization
manual dictionary capacity tracking used only by that mirror
unused RawSymbol C-string pointer mirror and trailing NUL storage

contract.before: Owner records are authoritative, but updates also maintain unused C-layout payload copies.
contract.after: Vtable and Symbol Oops retain identity/header only; existing owner records hold dictionaries and bytes. Public owner operations, tracing and lookup remain current.
contract.representation_change: Native vtable and Symbol payload extents become zero. Extent queries still report actual allocation facts; no public payload layout is promised to foreign owners.

necessity_review.allocation: Retain contiguous allocations, vtable headers, identity/extent and detach/release ordering. No payload catalog.
necessity_review.dictionaries: Retain ordered strong key/Method Oop pairs, parent links, lookup indexes and explicit invalidation. They serve current lookup and reflection.
necessity_review.symbols: Retain canonical identity, owned bytes and weak retirement. No selector-name-specific cache or C-string mirror.
necessity_review.bootstrap: Retain native Method/Name/Fault/Sequence constructors and module declarations required to cold-load owners. Their payload formats stay in bootstrap implementations.
necessity_review.continuations: Retain direct work entry, lookup continuation, answer delivery, budget/pause and native ancestry checks. No Execution or scheduler payload is read.
necessity_review.live_queries: Retain sameNativeMethod/nativeMethodIndex and current binding/allocation/representation facts used by Integer, Word and other owners. These are generic owner facts; no new public query was introduced.
necessity_review.removed: Unreachable old ABI files, weak/non-callable dictionary entries, constructor epoch bypass, unused queries/helpers and redundant raw mirrors.

limitations: This establishes the reasons for retained mechanisms, not a proof of unique mathematical minimality.
The other-module obsolete-source audit is still in progress.
